title: For Abdul Razzaq, leaving for London
titleOriginal: عبدالرزاق دی لندن روانگی تے — قطعہ
takeaway: Be happy where you're going, and don't forget the people who love you here.
scene: A short farewell for someone named Abdul Razzaq, who was moving to London.

original: اینان پیار دے گندھیاں ہاراں نوں
اینان ہاں دیاں غم خواراں نوں
transliteration: Inaan pyaar de gundhiyaan haaraan nu
translation: these friends of your own age who share your sorrows,
couplets.story: He thinks of the garlands of flowers made with love for the goodbye, and of all the friends his own age who care about him.
He wishes him a happy life abroad, and asks him not to forget the friends he's leaving behind.

why: A simple, sweet goodbye that anyone could say to a friend moving away.
prompt: Who would you want to remember you if you moved far away?
